title: potions+10
description: this mods adds new potions and adds bottle forms of effects that dont have bottles
body:
this mod adds 6+ new potions to the game like

potion of tank
1-3 turtle master potion
1 iron nugget

potion of suffering
1-3 harming potion
1 iron nugget

potion of aquatic (brewing stand)
1-3 water breathing potion
1 raw dolphin (droped my dolphins)

potion of dark (brewing stand)
1-3 awkward potion
1 ink sac

potion of haste (brewing stand)
1 diamond
1-3 bottle of chorus fruit (1 bottle of water 1 chorus fruit)

potion of random telaportation 
1-3 bottle of chorus fruit (1 bottle of water 1 chorus fruit)
crystal ender pearl (![the crystal ender pearl](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce6bd50ebca9e52eda90f25a1b7857ceb679047b.png) )
